fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-08-23 around 21:45 hrs, it was reported that the shutter of Thendral Mobiles near Mangai Layout Shopping Complex was found forced and goods worth about Rs. 40,000 were missing. Contact details given by the complainant, Tamilarasan Palanisamy, include the number 9000000023. The complainant is associated with the business Thendral Mobiles. The complainant could not identify the person involved. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Shutter allegedly forced at night and stock taken.
fields.Keywords: burglary, shop break-in, photograph, night, shopping complex, CCTV
